bio.text: Steven Shook is the Democratic nominee for Texas's 26th Congressional District in the November 2026 election; the Denton Record-Chronicle reports that he edged out Ernest Lineberger III for the nomination in the March primary.
The Denton Record-Chronicle describes Shook as a critical care and trauma-trained nurse with nearly 20 years of experience.
